jobs.title: Senior Associate, Product Analytics & Applied AI
jobs.description:
About Owner

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.



Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.



Our vision



We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.



But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.



Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.



In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.



Our traction



Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com http://Owner.com website.



More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.



Our team



Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.



We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.



Where we work



Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!





Why we're looking for you

 

We’re building a highly impactful, data & AI-first Product Analytics function at Owner.com http://Owner.com. As a Senior Associate, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the product roadmap through close collaboration with Product Managers to establish opportunity impact sizing, product effectiveness tracking, and direct product strategy & tactical contributions. 

Your work will shift to wherever the highest impact lies - whether that's deep root-cause analysis on product opportunity areas, sizing the expected impact of new features to shape engineering priorities, designing & providing visibility to product health metrics, or directly contributing to the development of analytics and AI-powered product features. The best candidates will not simply provide insights to the EPD (Engineering & Product) org, but be a strategic and operational driver, identifying gaps/opportunities, recommending product roadmap improvements, and creating overall meaningful business impact through direct influence on the product.

 

This role is 100% remote and can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada.

 

You should apply if you ...

 

 - Have felt torn about whether to pursue a business vs pure technical/analytical career path (at Owner, we believe these must merge)

 - Identify inefficiencies in everyday life - and see them as exciting opportunities.

 - Aren't satisfied with understanding things at a surface level, and get satisfaction from understanding the root cause (the WHY)

 - When solving problems, you enjoy diving deeply in them to understand root causes and become a "subject matter expert”, but know when to stop “overbuilding”

 - Aren't afraid of and enjoy picking up new skills and tools to problem-solve

 - Enjoy tinkering and testing (or building) applications for AI tools like Claude Code, Codex

 - Want to build solutions for lasting processes and systems. Love a good data-driven decision-making process (but also understand when this is possible and when it isn't)

 - Have a proven track record of collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
   
   

The impact you'll have



 - Influence Product Planning Roadmap: Influence product planning through informative impact sizing, enabling more strategic decision-making for Owner.

 - Uncover Product Gaps, and Recommend/Action Resolutions: Analyze the root cause for product success metric gaps and issues, and recommend immediate resolution pathways, or action them yourself.

 - Own Your Product Pod’s Analytics: Improve the analytics and engagement strategy for your product pod(s). This isn't just an insights role - you'll design and ship data products and automated AI workflows that enable teams to act on data without waiting for analysis.

 - Tackle emerging priorities: Lead or contribute to ad hoc projects as business needs arise; this role flexes with what matters most.

 - Ultimately, help grow our customers’ sales and improve their experience: Across all product pods, the mission is uniform: improve our customer’s experience and help customers grow their sales with Owner.com http://Owner.com.



Who you’ll work with



 - Reporting Structure: This role reports directly to Mark Rogal, Manager, Product Analytics & Applied AI

 - Team Collaboration: You will be embedded within up to two product squads (preferably one), working closely with Product Managers, designers, and developers within their regular sprint cadence.

 - Technical Collaboration: You will collaborate with Analytics Engineers on all technical aspects, including data modeling, data quality, and the use of tools like DBT and Snowflake.

 - Executive Visibility: The work in this role directly drives product strategy, which means regular exposure to senior and executive leadership.



What we're looking for



 - 4+ years in analytics, strategy, or ops - whether that's management consulting, startup analytics, or a hybrid path that's hard to label

 - Extremely strong quantitative skills, with additional technical background or education strongly preferred. SQL/Python/Claude Code/Codex and product analytics experience is a strong plus

 - You've built things - dashboards, tools, processes - not just delivered decks

 - You dig into root causes until you actually understand the problem, not just the symptoms

 - Comfortable with ambiguity; you don't need a playbook to figure out what to work on next

 - Experience with SaaS, marketplaces, or high-growth startups preferred

 - Restaurant industry experience is a plus
   
   
   

Compensation and benefits

 - The estimated base salary range for this role is $160,000 - $200,000 USD depending on such factors such as level, experience and location. The offer will also include a generous pre-IPO equity package

 - Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, remote first, unlimited PTO - plus extra fun perks!



What our interview process looks like



Step 1: Recruiter Phone Screen

Begin with a conversation with a recruiter to evaluate your background, better understand what you’re looking for in your next opportunity, and answer any early questions you may have about the role or company.

 

Step 2: Hiring Manager Interview

Participate in a 45-minute video interview with the hiring manager. This conversation will go deeper into your experience, approach to work, and views on problem-solving and collaboration.

 

Step 3: Technical Case Study (Pass/Fail)

Receive a technical case study to complete independently. You will have seven days to submit your assignment. The team will review your submission and provide detailed feedback on whether you have passed or not passed this stage.

 

Step 4: Full Round / Case Study Presentation

If you pass the technical case study, you'll move forward to a 60-minute presentation round with several members of the Business Operations team. You'll walk the team through your approach, thought process, and recommendations, and answer live follow-up questions.

 

Step 5: Final / Executive Interviews

The final stage consists of one to two executive interviews with C-suite leadership team members. These 30-minute conversations focus on overall alignment, communication, strategic thinking, and long-term fit with the business.





Notice - Employment Scams

Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address.



We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by a scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond.

Why we’re looking for you

We’re hiring a product leader to run Lighthouse end-to-end — a PM who wants to run and build a business line (product + operating model), and who is excited to be forward-deployed with our biggest customers. You’ll spend meaningful time in the field building relationships with sophisticated restaurant groups, and you’ll turn that signal into a scalable product + operating model. Our ambition is to start and scale a business line that can become $100M+ ARR.

 The impact you'll have



 - Define and run the Lighthouse strategy and operating model: ICP, value prop, entitlements, and success metrics.

 - Build a differentiated Lighthouse customer experience across pre-sale, launch, and ongoing value delivery.

 - Partner tightly with Sales, Launch, Customer Success, Support, RevOps, and Engineering to keep deals moving and customers successful.

 - Drive the Lighthouse roadmap and ship multi-location capabilities into the one platform (not a fork).

 - Spend meaningful time with customers in the field and translate signal into shipped outcomes



Who you’ll work with



 - Report directly to VP Product.

 - Partner closely with leaders across Sales, Launch, CS/Support, RevOps, Marketing, and Engineering.



 What we’re looking for



 - 5+ years of Product Management experience.

 - Builder mindset — thrives in ambiguity, prototypes quickly, and learns by building.

 - Technically fluent — comfortable reading code, reasoning about systems, and partnering deeply with engineers.

 - Rapid prototyper — uses AI, SQL, Figma, no-code, or lightweight code to validate ideas and accelerate execution.

 - Strong product operator — proven track record of shipping high-impact products.

 - Customer obsessed — excels at discovery, relationship building, and translating customer needs into product direction.

 - Business-minded — understands unit economics, GTM strategy, and growth levers.

 - Cross-functional leader — aligns teams and drives decisions across engineering, design, and go-to-market.

 - Founder mentality — end-to-end ownership with an entrepreneurial approach; former founders are a strong plus.

Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Why we’re looking for you



Running a restaurant is a constant stream of decisions, exceptions, and tradeoffs. Most restaurant software gives operators more outputs: more dashboards, more alerts, more settings, more reports, and more things to check.




Owner is built around a different idea: software should help restaurants achieve outcomes. Our mobile and desktop experiences combine the essential tools operators need to run the business with the intelligence to tell them what matters, what to do next, and increasingly help do it for them.




We’re hiring a Principal Product Manager to own and scale this AI-native operator experience for restaurants. You’ll bring together the daily workflows operators rely on, from orders and guest issues to settings, performance, and growth opportunities. The goal is a cohesive product experience that turns signals into clear recommendations, simple actions, and trusted AI-assisted execution.




This is a hands-on, forward-deployed builder PM role for someone who wants to be close to the work: in restaurants, in kitchens, in text threads with operators, and alongside our frontline teams. You’ll pair that direct operator intuition with strong product taste and the technical judgment required to ship automation in messy, real-world workflows involving orders, menus, integrations, data quality, permissions, and reliability.




This role is 100% remote and can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada.



 The impact you'll have



 - Shift restaurant software from outputs to outcomes. Build experiences that synthesize what matters, explain why it matters, recommend the next best action, and make it easy to act.

 - Own the core operator experience across mobile and desktop. Bring together the workflows restaurants rely on every day, including orders, guest issues, operational settings, business performance, and growth opportunities, into a cohesive product experience.

 - Build personalized business guidance. Show restaurants the value Owner is driving, identify the highest-impact opportunities, and deliver the right recommendation across product, email, SMS, customer success, and AI agent experiences.

 - Scale unified guest and order management. Help restaurants monitor, manage, and resolve reviews, support requests, forms, order issues, and operational exceptions quickly.

 - Productize best-practice playbooks into simple actions. Turn proven operator and customer-success workflows into personalized recommendations, one-tap actions, and safe automation.

 - Earn trust in AI-assisted execution. Design the permissions, confirmations, evaluation loops, rollback paths, and failure handling needed for restaurants to trust Owner with increasingly important work.

 - Operate forward-deployed. Spend meaningful time with restaurant owners and teams — in restaurants, in kitchens, over text, and alongside our support and success teams — to understand what actually happens day to day. Turn that proximity into sharper product priorities, better AI behavior, and products that feel like real leverage for operators.

 - Lead through ambiguity. Align product, design, engineering, data, AI, customer success, and operations around the highest-impact operator outcomes.
   
   

 What we’re looking for



 - 8+ years of product management experience, or equivalent building experience, with a track record of shipping high-impact products.

 - Forward-deployed customer obsession. You build conviction by getting close to the work: visiting restaurants, observing live workflows, texting with operators, shadowing frontline teams, and understanding how work actually gets done before deciding what to build.

 - AI product instincts grounded in real operations. You think in loops — signals → decisions → actions → learning — and care deeply about quality, trust, and iteration.

 - Excellent product judgment and taste. You can reduce cognitive load, simplify messy workflows, and design products that feel obvious to busy, non-technical users.

 - Technical depth and strong engineering partnership. You can reason about systems, data flows, integrations, permissions, reliability, and tradeoffs.

 - Bias toward outcomes over features. You know how to connect product work to customer and business impact, not just launches.

 - Strong prioritization and execution. You can balance speed, correctness, and long-term maintainability in a fast-moving environment.

 - Cross-functional leadership. You can align opinionated stakeholders, create clarity from ambiguity, and keep teams moving.


Compensation and benefits



 - The estimated starting base salary range for this role is $280- $300K, plus a generous pre-IPO equity package

 - Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, remote-first workplace, unlimited PTO - plus extra fun perks!

Why we're looking for you
Owner helps restaurants run and grow their businesses online. Our product is moving quickly, and the opportunity is not simply to announce more features. It is to make every important product investment easier to sell, easier to adopt, and more valuable to the restaurants that use it.

We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager who can connect product velocity to commercial impact. You will help our frontline teams win the right customers, retain the customers we have, and clearly explain why Owner is the better choice. You will turn customer and market insight into positioning, proof, enablement, adoption programs, and feedback that shapes what we build next.

This is a GTM-focused role. Launches and communications are tools in the system, not the outcome by themselves. The outcome is stronger win rates, healthier retention, better adoption, and a frontline team that can confidently make the value of Owner clear.

This role is fully remote and can be based in the United States or Canada.

The impact you'll have
Build positioning, messaging, proof points, battlecards, talk tracks, objection handling, and customer stories that improve competitive win rates.

 - Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Support to understand what helps them close, onboard, adopt, retain, and expand customers.

 - Identify adoption blockers and churn risks, then turn product capabilities into practical retention and expansion plays.

 - Create scalable enablement systems and workflows that keep the frontline current without relying on one more training session.

 - Bring win/loss insight, customer feedback, competitive context, and adoption signals into Product and Marketing planning.

 - Define the audiences and customer behaviors that matter most for priority capabilities, then build GTM programs that move those behaviors.

 - Partner with Product early to clarify the customer problem, sharpen the value proposition, and make the eventual GTM motion stronger before development is complete.

 - Use launches, customer communications, in-product moments, and other channels selectively when they drive a measurable customer or commercial outcome.

 - Use AI to increase the speed and quality of research, content creation, analysis, and enablement while maintaining a high bar for accuracy.
   

Who you'll work with

 - The VP of Marketing and Product Marketing team.

 - Product and EPD partners, from early discovery through rollout.

 - Enablement, Sales, Customer Success, and Support.

 - Customer Marketing, Growth Marketing, Community, and Brand/Events.



What we're looking for

 - 3+ years of experience in product marketing, go-to-market, sales enablement, customer marketing, or a closely related role in technology.

 - A track record of improving a commercial or customer outcome, such as win rate, adoption, retention, expansion, or frontline effectiveness.

 - Experience turning complex product capabilities into clear positioning and practical tools for customer-facing teams.

 - Strong customer and market judgment. You can connect objections, competitive dynamics, customer needs, and churn or adoption signals to what the business should do next.

 - A systems mindset. You build repeatable workflows that scale with product velocity and make it easier for teams to do the right thing.

 - Excellent writing and presentation skills. You can make a value proposition compelling and a frontline asset immediately useful.

 - Comfort working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and Marketing.

 - An AI-forward approach to your work. You actively use AI to move faster without sacrificing accuracy, judgment, or customer empathy.



How we'll evaluate your work

As part of the process, you will work through a practical scenario involving a priority product capability with an adoption or competitive win-rate challenge. We will ask you to diagnose the problem, identify the target audience, develop the positioning and frontline plays, propose a focused rollout, and define how you would measure impact.

Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, a remote-first workplace, unlimited PTO, and additional perks.
